summary: Executed independent backend pytest suite (9 tests) and frontend Playwright flow across auth, navigation, connections, transactions, dashboard, reports, and PDF download trigger.

minor.issue: Returns 400 because GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID/GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET are not configured in backend/.env (expected in current env).
Returns 400 because PLAID_CLIENT_ID/PLAID_SECRET are missing in backend/.env (expected in current env).

integration_issues.issue: Frontend shows disabled/config-required state and backend start route fails until Google credentials are provided.
Connect with Plaid action fails gracefully due to missing Plaid credentials; full link flow not executable.

integration_issues.flow: AI custom insights in report generation
integration_issues.issue: Prompt accepted but Gemini insights are not generated because GEMINI_API_KEY/GEMINI_MODEL are empty.

issues: Native browser date input picker is used instead of a custom calendar component (consistency concern).

action_items: Add real GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID and GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET to enable full Google OAuth flow.
Add real PLAID_CLIENT_ID and PLAID_SECRET to enable full Plaid link-token and account linking flow.
Add GEMINI_API_KEY and GEMINI_MODEL to enable AI insights section in generated reports.
Consider replacing native date inputs with a consistent app calendar component if required by UX standards.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py performs multiple blocking requests library calls inside async endpoints (Google/Plaid/Gemini-related flows), which can reduce concurrency under load; migrate to async HTTP client for production resilience.

success_rate.frontend: 100% core tested flows; third-party flows config-blocked

seed_data_creation: No new seed scripts created. Runtime test data created via API (manual account/transaction/report).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All requested core flows passed in this environment. Third-party integrations (Google OAuth, Plaid, Gemini AI insights) remain blocked by missing env credentials and should be retested after keys are added.
rca of the issue: Not functional defects in tested core app logic. Failures are configuration-driven: missing third-party credentials in backend/.env directly trigger 400 responses for Google/Plaid routes and disable Gemini AI output.
